newsitem.title: USA: Century Telephone to buy Pecoco Inc.
newsitem.headline: Century Telephone to buy Pecoco Inc.

text.p: Century Telephone Enterprises Inc said on Friday it signed a definitive agreement to acquire Pecoco Inc.
Pecoco, which offers local exchange telephone services in four counties in Wisconsin, also provides cable television services and has a minority ownership interest in two cellular partnerships.
Glen Post III, Century's president and chief executive, said the purchase brings the number of access lines in Wisconsin to more than 112,000.
Century said it plans to close the deal in the first quarter of 1997.
